body.x: Perfitt participated in the world's largest technology exhibition CES 2020 opening in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10 to showcase its AI engine for personalized shoe fit recommendation.
People often have difficulty in choosing the right size when they are shopping for shoes online. It is also a hassle to exchange them if the shoes do not fit.
By using the app Perfitt, this problem goes away. Just take a picture of your foot, and the foot size is measured in just 10 seconds.

CEO Steena S Lee said, "We came to CES 2020 to look for online shoe shopping malls. We are sure that our app will help your company improve the retail process. We will be happy to introduce our app to anyone who comes to our booth."

The world's largest IT show CES shows the trend of the global consumer electronics industry at a glance. It is hosted by Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January. AVING NEWS has reported the most news on CES, MWC, and IFA, the world's three major tech exhibitions for the past 13 years. It is sending special reporters to CES this year to report major issues in the global market and introduce outstanding Korean companies to the world.
